# Ali Alfatemi — AI/ML Researcher Building Reliable Intelligent Systems

> Computer Science Ph.D. Candidate at Fordham University (New York, NY).
> Building practical machine-learning systems across security, computer vision,
> language, medical imaging, robotics, blockchain, bioinformatics, and forecasting.
> The record presented here includes 31 publications and 1 granted patent.
> Ph.D. expected May 2027; available for postdoctoral and faculty appointments,
> as well as Research Scientist, Applied Scientist,
> and Machine Learning Engineer positions in industry.

## Research Areas

- **Reliable and Efficient Machine Learning**: Compact models, robust learning, synthetic data, meta-learning, decision fusion, and methods for limited, noisy, or imbalanced data.
- **Security and Autonomous Systems**: Learning-based cyber defense, reinforcement learning, symbolic safeguards, edge and IoT intelligence, robotics, and trustworthy distributed systems.
- **Vision and Multimodal Intelligence**: Fine-grained recognition, medical image segmentation, vision–language generation, object detection, and boundary-aware visual learning.
- **Language, Health, and Data Applications**: Arabic grammatical error correction, multi-omics patient subgrouping, autism diagnostics, sports forecasting, and cryptocurrency modeling.

## Key Skills & Expertise

- Deep Learning, Machine Learning, Neural Network Architectures
- Reinforcement Learning, Neuro-Symbolic AI, Explainable AI
- Network Security, Autonomous Cyber Defense, Edge and IoT Intelligence
- Computer Vision, Medical Image Segmentation, Object Detection, Image Classification
- Large Language Models, Natural Language Processing, Vision-Language Models, Multimodal AI
- Meta-Learning, Few-Shot Learning, Prototypical Networks
- Data Augmentation, GAN-based Augmentation, Noise Tolerance
- Federated Learning, Distributed Machine Learning, Trustworthy AI
- Python, PyTorch, TensorFlow, Scikit-learn
- Bioinformatics, Multi-omics Data Integration, Forecasting, Blockchain Systems
